title: By Council Member Wong: Pursuant to Rule 11.20(b) of the Council Rules and Section 19-160.2 of the New York City Administrative Code, the Council resolves that the action of the Department of Transportation approving a sidewalk café located at 60-01 70th Avenue, Ridgewood, NY 11385, Borough of Queens, Council District 30, Community District 5, related to Application No.: D 2650082809 SWQ (Cozy Corner) shall be subject to review by the Council.
